ja257:1.1: Nāyaṃ gharānaṃ kusalo, lolo ayaṃ valīmukho, kataṃ kataṃ kho dūseyya, evaṃdhammam idaṃ kulan ti.
ja257:2.1: Na idaṃ cittavato lomaṃ, nāyaṃ assāsiko migo, satthaṃ me Janasandhena: nāyaṃ kiñci vijānatīti.
ja257:3.1: Na mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā bhātaraṃ bhaginiṃ sakhaṃ bhareyya tādiso poso, satthaṃ Dasarathena me ti.
